description:
Pass your electrical licensing exam and actually understand the Code while you do it.

JCR Productions has trained 20,000+ electricians since 1985 with a 93% first-time pass rate, using our "Code Made Simple" method: learn the principles, don't just memorize answers. This channel gives you free Code breakdowns, exam strategy, and lessons pulled straight from our paid NEC training. Study smarter and take the NEC exam with confidence.

Getting licensed or knocking out CE hours? We teach every way you want to learn:
⚡ In-person Workshops - Raleigh, Charlotte/Mooresville, Asheville & Greensboro
⚡ Live online classes over Zoom
⚡ Self-paced video + manual self-study
⚡ 500+ question mock exams, workbooks & permanent Code-book tabs
⚡ Private on-site training for teams, unions & companies (CE reporting in 20+ states)

👉 Start here: jcrproductions.com
📝 Free digital practice exam: quiz.jcrproductions.com
